text:
Silver Price in 1969
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1969, the LBMA silver price fell 10.5% between 1969-01-31 ($2.00) and 1969-12-31 ($1.79). The highest sampled price was $2.00 in January and the lowest was $1.56 in June. The mean of these observations was $1.80. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
